diagnosis.observed: The two captures selected only because they were the smallest exact members produced below-reference windows but no positive window.
diagnosis.invalid_old_inference: Those two capture outcomes do not prove that the whole DLR family is unsuitable.

diagnosis.observed: Both downloaded .sens captures had a single all-zero depth/color timestamp value.
diagnosis.invalid_old_process: A small header/index/time-grid probe should have detected this before full payload acquisition.

unchanged_scientific_gates.window_grid: Per capture, non-overlapping half-open windows anchored at the earliest synchronized source timestamp; incomplete trailing windows are excluded; no sliding.
unchanged_scientific_gates.abstention_policy: No imputation. A failed or unevaluable pair remains in the fixed denominator.

allowed_access: HTTP object identity headers and byte-range response identity
archive central directory, ROS bag connection/index records, HDF5 object headers, or equivalent container metadata
member names, source timestamps, counts, dimensions, encodings, calibration identity, and pose/depth topic identity
transient container decompression when metadata cannot otherwise be addressed, followed by immediate discard
forbidden_access: RGB image decode, materialization, rendering, inspection, model input, or selection influence
depth value decode or pose-coordinate access before candidate-lock review
geometry formula execution before candidate-lock review
motion-role assignment from names, descriptions, published labels, thumbnails, or metadata
optimized_pre_payload_probe.failure_scope: A failed probe rejects only the probed capture unless official format evidence proves that the defect necessarily applies to the entire source family.

optimized_capture_selection.candidate_lock_requirement: Every exact capture must pass the pre-payload time-grid probe before it can be locked.
deterministic_selection_order: Preserve source-family independence and historical R3 family exclusions.
Prefer captures that jointly provide at least two complete synchronized 10-second window slots and at least two capture identities.
Publisher labels may be used only to stratify coverage and avoid a homogeneous capture set; they grant no positive or below-reference role.
Within an equally stratified eligible set, maximize the number of complete synchronized 10-second window slots.
Break remaining ties by lower geometry-only payload bytes, then lexicographic capture id.
optimized_capture_selection.lock_size_rule: Lock the smallest deterministic eligible set that satisfies the time-grid redundancy rule and the remaining cumulative transport budget. Additional captures require a separately reviewed successor lock and cannot be added after geometry outcomes are seen in the current lock.

failure_and_reuse_semantics.whole_family_unsuitable_claim: Requires official family-wide format evidence or exhaustion of every exact capture in a separately frozen family registry; it cannot be inferred from one or two capture failures.
failure_and_reuse_semantics.historical_payload_cleanup: Deleting re-downloadable payload does not delete identity, member, hash, result, ledger, or cleanup-receipt evidence.
failure_and_reuse_semantics.wave1_mutability: Wave 1 lock, outcomes, validation, and cleanup remain immutable and are not reinterpreted as a pass.

terminal_rules.success: Two independent source families each provide one geometry-only positive and one geometry-only below-reference window under the unchanged gates.
terminal_rules.continue: Open a separately reviewed successor candidate lock without lowering gates, changing the algorithm, running RGB, starting Android, or appending outcome-selected captures to an existing lock.
